deploy-bot: Production deploy initiated
deploy-bot: env=prod region=us-west-2 release=release-3.6.2 commit=9f8b1a author=jen ts=1729456789
jen (release-engineering): starting canary rollout -> 5% traffic. tagging commit: `git tag -a release-3.6.2 9f8b1a -m "prod cutover 3.6.2"` :shipit:
kai (eng-platform): ack, warming instances. autoscaling policy set to 'cutover-boost' for 30m
maria (sre): smoke tests kicked off (health, latency, model-outputs). running eval subset: `evals/smoke/promptset-quick`
omar (oncall): watching error budget, alerts set to critical on 5xx spike. paging policy active
maria (sre): quick check: 200s/200 ok, median lat 84ms for canary
kai (eng-platform): routing 5% -> release-3.6.2, rest stays on release-3.6.1. KV cache warmup in progress
jen (release-engineering): note: pinning release-3.6.2 for 2h to avoid automated roll-forward. tagging internal ticket RI-1423
maria (sre): found one minor regression in reranker outputs on long contexts, SLO impact negligible but logging more. opened issue infra#372
omar (oncall): recommend proceeding but keep canary at 5% for +15m for more telemetry
jen (release-engineering): agreed, extend canary hold +15m. manual intervention required to increase beyond 5%
(15m passes)
maria (sre): canary metrics stable: errors flat, latency stable, quality signals nominal
kai (eng-platform): increasing rollout to 30% now
deploy-bot: rollout update: release-3.6.2 traffic=30% commit=9f8b1a
omar (oncall): monitoring dashboard: no anomalies. preparing to open windows for full cutover at 60% in 10m
jen (release-engineering): reminder: change window until 18:10 PT, do not promote other releases into prod during this window
kai (eng-platform): starting gradual shift to 60%
maria (sre): running post-shift smoke; minor increased tail latency on a subset of requests, not correlated with errors. tracking
jen (release-engineering): decision: continue to 100% unless errors > 0.5% or latency regression > +100ms p95
omar (oncall): agreed
(10m passes)
deploy-bot: final traffic shift complete. release-3.6.2 now at 100% in prod region=us-west-2 commit=9f8b1a duration=00:31:46
maria (sre): final smoke: all health checks green, observability confirms no error-rate regressions, p95 latency +18ms
jen (release-engineering): unpinning release-3.6.2, leaving tag and notes. Release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.6.2
kai (eng-platform): scaleback autoscaling policy to default, cache TTL restored
omar (oncall): closing watch, will keep a 1h post-cutover monitoring window
deploy-bot: Production deploy completed successfully. changelog: minor reranker fix, perf tuning for KV cache. tickets: RI-1423, infra#372
jen (release-engineering): thanks team! will draft external release note and docs update this afternoon :tada:
maria (sre): adding regression alert signatures to catch the reranker drift issue
omar (oncall): all good from oncall side
kai (eng-platform): dropping final logs into release audit: /var/logs/release-audits/1729456789.log
jen (release-engineering): marking thread resolved and closing CI gates.
